name: Snail Mail
description:
Once per day, you may spend an action to command this chainmail to excrete a thick layer of slime along its surface for one hour. While it is covered in slime, the wearer may lay against and crawl along any surface (including walls and ceilings), but may only move at 1/10th their normal speed. They leave a visible trail of slime that evaporates after one hour.

Any object that touches the mail while slimy becomes stuck to it. A creature may roll Strength against a Difficulty of 16 to attempt to remove it. A failed check means the object remains stuck while the hour lasts.

When the hour has passed, the slime is absorbed into the mail.
